latestRejection.rejectionReason:
Experience is intuitive, coherent, and complete: - Multiplayer isn't working. It first said "Race Cannot Continue: Retry" so I did, and its been sitting on finding an opponent for at least a minute and is only at 25%. If there is no actual player, they need to be given a bot with a guest username. 
- There was a bug when I won the first level. I couldn't click the "Next Level" button for a bit. Then it finally turned yellow. 
- The coin shop: You don't need "X number of coins added to your account." That is what the X number of coins as the title means. 
- When you first go into Challenge a friend, it says "race can't continue" immediately. "Retry" and it brings up the actual invite a friend portion. 
- Out of Attempts Panel: It says "Out of Attempts" twice 
- Had a little glitch: I retried a level and couldn't click a button for a few seconds.

Other notes: Hey Craig! The loading in the normal gameplay has gotten much, much better!
